headline: They will lay off almost everyone. This is the end of a furniture factory
summary: The Andrewex solid-wood furniture plant in Sławno, West Pomerania, will stop production by the end of January 2027. Group redundancies will cover almost 90% of the workforce.
why: Plant closures and mass layoffs in regional manufacturing signal weakening demand or cost pressures in the sector. They also affect local employment and the company's financial position.
original_headline: Zwolnią prawie wszystkich. To koniec zakładu meblarskiego
